blocks.text: Inheritance allows one class to inherit attributes and methods from another class. This promotes code reuse and creates a hierarchical relationship between classes.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The Dog and Cat classes are printed without indentation, which is an IndentationError. Each def make_sound(self): must be indented inside its class, and each print() indented once more under its def.
Explanation: In the above code Dog and Cat inherit from Animal. Each subclass can override the make_sound() method to produce specific sounds.
